en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Alpine town nestled in a valley surrounded by forested hills and high snow-covered peaks. The town has clustered houses, a prominent church with twin towers and another steeple, and a winding road in the foreground where a couple of people walk. On the right slope a woman in a long dress stands in the grass. The lower part of the card is mostly blank with the town name printed in ornate red script.
